description: This file defines an interface 'ThingException' in the package 'org.eclipse.ditto.model.things', which serves as an aggregator for exceptions related to 'Thing' objects within the Eclipse Ditto framework. It primarily provides a constant error code prefix used for identifying such exceptions.

classes.name: ThingException
classes.description: Interface for all exceptions related to 'Thing' objects, providing a common error code prefix.
